# LulaZel Digital Studio

> LulaZel Digital Studio designs and builds websites, online stores, apps and business systems for South African businesses. Strategy, design, development, hosting and launch under one roof. Websites from R18,000.

LulaZel Digital Studio (also written LulaZel, Lulazel, Lula Zel, LulaZel Studio, LulaZel Digital) is a digital studio based in Johannesburg, South Africa, working with businesses nationwide and remotely. It was founded by Lulamile Mkhungela and has been designing and building since 2019.

## Key facts

- Name: LulaZel Digital Studio (short: LulaZel)
- Location: Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa — serves all of South Africa and remote clients
- Founder: Lulamile Mkhungela
- Building since: 2019
- Projects shipped or in progress: 31
- Website: https://www.lulazel.co.za/
- Email: mkhungela.l@gmail.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +27837195064

## Services

- [Web Hosting](https://www.lulazel.co.za/services/web-hosting/): South African hosting setup, provider selection and ongoing website management.
- [Website Design](https://www.lulazel.co.za/services/website-design/): Website design and frontend development for South African businesses, HTML email design and integrations.
- [Ecommerce](https://www.lulazel.co.za/services/ecommerce/): Online stores and ecommerce for South African businesses, an easy journey from product to checkout.
- [Business Systems](https://www.lulazel.co.za/services/business-systems/): Custom business systems, tools, portals and dashboards built around South African operations.
- [Workflow Automation & AI](https://www.lulazel.co.za/services/workflow-automation/): Workflow automation and practical AI for South African businesses, cutting repetitive work.
- [AI Assistants](https://www.lulazel.co.za/services/ai-assistants/): AI assistants that help customers and teams in South Africa find answers in your knowledge.
- [Basic Graphic Design](https://www.lulazel.co.za/services/basic-graphic-design/): Simple, consistent graphic design for South African social, digital and print needs.
- [SEO & Search](https://www.lulazel.co.za/services/seo-and-search/): SEO and search that helps relevant South African customers discover your business.
- [Google Ads](https://www.lulazel.co.za/services/google-ads/): Focused Google Ads campaigns in South Africa with clear enquiry and sales goals.
- [Product Design & Strategy](https://www.lulazel.co.za/product-design-strategy/): Product design and strategy for South African teams — research, direction and usable experiences.

## Starting prices (South African Rand)

- Website: from R18,000 — Service businesses, professionals and startups that need a credible site that turns visitors into enquiries. ([Website Design](https://www.lulazel.co.za/services/website-design/))
- Online store: from R40,000 — Brands and retailers ready to sell online with a smooth path from product to checkout. ([Ecommerce](https://www.lulazel.co.za/services/ecommerce/))
- App: from R38,000 — Founders and teams turning an idea into a usable web or mobile product. ([Product Design & Strategy](https://www.lulazel.co.za/product-design-strategy/))
- Business system: from R50,000 — Growing businesses replacing spreadsheets and messages with one connected tool. ([Business Systems](https://www.lulazel.co.za/services/business-systems/))
- Graphic design: from R14,000 — Businesses that need consistent, professional assets built on their existing identity. ([Basic Graphic Design](https://www.lulazel.co.za/services/basic-graphic-design/))
- Web Hosting: custom quote — Provider selection, setup, SSL, backups and ongoing website care.
- Workflow Automation & AI: custom quote — Connect your tools and remove repetitive admin with agreed business rules.
- AI Assistants: custom quote — Assistants that answer from your approved knowledge, with human escalation.
- SEO & Search: custom quote — Technical foundations, search intent and content that helps customers find you.
- Google Ads: custom quote — Focused campaigns with clear goals, tracking and ongoing optimisation.

Prices exclude third-party costs such as hosting plans, domains, payment fees and ad spend. Every project gets a written quote before work begins.

## Selected work

- [Nerdma](https://www.lulazel.co.za/project/nerdma/): Website redesign and product dashboards that connect Nerdma’s governance, risk and sustainability offer.
- [SNB](https://www.lulazel.co.za/project/snb/): Website design, responsive build and CMS handover for SnB Chartered Accountants & Auditors.
- [FoodieZone](https://www.lulazel.co.za/project/foodiezone/): An ordering PWA designed around a local kitchen, a clear menu and an easier path to reorder.
- [LulaFind](https://www.lulazel.co.za/project/lulafind/): Missing-person posters, sightings, danger alerts, surname communities, stories and private chat in one installable app.
- [Sesyme](https://www.lulazel.co.za/project/sesyme/): A co-learning app our founder created while working at Sesyme in 2019, with question-and-answer learning and a digital reading experience.
- [LuniaNetwork](https://www.lulazel.co.za/project/lunianetwork/): A personal app our founder developed and published in 2019 for finding loved ones or items and connecting with people. It was removed from Google Play in 2024 because it was no longer being updated.
- [ProdOps](https://www.lulazel.co.za/project/prodops/): A role-based product workspace connecting business, design, development, quality and delivery.
- [Forma Design System](https://www.lulazel.co.za/project/forma/): A work-in-progress design-to-code system connecting Figma, typed tokens, React, Angular and Storybook.

## Frequently asked questions

### What does a project cost?

Starting prices are on our Pricing page — for example, websites start from R18,000. After a short conversation you get a clear written quote covering scope, deliverables and timing before any work begins. Nothing starts until you approve it.

### How long does a project take?

Smaller design or setup work can move quickly; connected systems take longer. Timing is discussed and agreed before work starts, and kept visible through planned review points.

### Do you work with businesses outside South Africa?

Yes. LulaZel Digital Studio works remotely with businesses worldwide, whatever your time zone.

### Do I need a technical brief before we talk?

No. Bring the problem you want to solve — goals, examples and what you use today all help, but a complete technical brief is not required.

### What do hosting, payments and AI cost?

Those services come from the providers you choose and are billed under their terms. We set them up, connect them and manage them to the agreed scope; their fees are yours to pay directly to them.

### What happens after launch?

You receive everything we agreed — access, assets and documentation. Ongoing support and maintenance options are available and agreed before the work starts.
